column.value: Per receivable GL account for the period: CBS opening and closing receivable (charged and accrual basis) against the GL balances from loan postings, GL and posting variances, the penalty accrual gap, loans with variances, negative balances or exceptions, and a validation status.

update.column: with prod as ( select p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, max(case when m.financial_account_type = 7 then m.gl_account_id end) as int_gl, max(case when m.financial_account_type ounder.name as office_name, pr.product_name, pr.int_gl, pr.pen_gl from m_loan l join prod pr on pr.product_id = l.product_id left join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id left join m_group g on g.id = l.group_id join m_office ounder on ounder.id = coalesce(l.office_id, c.office_id, g.office_id) where ounder.hierarchy like concat('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') and (${officeId} in (-1, 0) or ounder.hierarchy like concat((select ho.hierarchy from m_office ho where ho.id = ${officeId}), '%')) and l.disbursedon_date is not null and l.disbursedon_date <= '${asOn}' and ('${currencyId}' in ('-1', '0') or l.currency_code = '${currencyId}') and ('${filterClientId}' in ('-1', '0') or l.client_id = '${filterClientId}') and ('${filterLoanId}' in ('-1', '0') or l.id = '${filterLoanId}') ), tx as ( select t.id as txn_id, t.loan_id, t.transaction_date as event_date, t.transaction_type_enum as tt, t.is_reversed, case when t.transaction_type_enum = 10 then 'Accrual' when and lc.is_penalty = 1), 0) else 0 end as pen_unposted from ln join m_loan_transaction t on t.loan_id = ln.loan_id where t.transaction_type_enum in (2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 17, 28, 30, 31, 32, 33) and t.transaction_date <= '${asOn}' ), chg as ( select lc.id as charge_id, lc.loan_id, lc.due_for_collection_as_of_date as event_date, lc.amount, if(lc.due_for_collection_as_of_date >= '${startDate}', 1, (ln.int_gl, ln.pen_gl) where je.entry_date <= '${asOn}' group by t.loan_id ), s_loan as ( select ln.loan_id, ln.total_overpaid, coalesce(a.txn_count, 0) as txn_count, a.last_txn_id, coalesce(a.int_open, 0) as int_open, coalesce(c.pen_charged_open, 0) + coalesce(a.pen_open, 0) as pen_open, coalesce(a.pen_open_posted, 0) as pen_open_posted, coalesce(a.int_accrued, 0) as pen_accrual_rev, coalesce(a.pen_received, 0) as pen_received, coalesce(a.pen_receipt_rev, 0) as pen_receipt_rev, coalesce(a.pen_waived, 0) as pen_waived, coalesce(a.pen_written_off, 0) as pen_received, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_receipt_rev, 0)) as pen_receipt_rev, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_waived, 0)) as pen_waived, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_written_off, 0)) as pen_written_off, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_adjusted, 0)) as pen_adjusted, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_relief_rev, 0)) as pen_relief_rev, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_waived_unposted, 0)) as pen_waived_unposted, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.int_mv, 0)) as int_mv, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_mv, 0)) as pen_mv, sum(if(g0.in_period = 1, g0.pen_mv_posted, 0)) as pen_mv_posted, sum(g0.int_accrued - g0.int_accrual_rev) as c_int_accrued_net, sum(g0.int_received - g0.int_receipt_rev) as c_int_received_net, sum(g0.pen_accrued - g0.pen_accrual_rev) as c_pen_accrued_net, m.in_period, count(*) as txn_count, max(m.txn_id) as last_txn_id, sum(m.int_accrued) as int_accrued, sum(m.int_accrual_rev) as int_accrual_rev, sum(m.int_received) as int_received, sum(m.int_receipt_rev) as int_receipt_rev, sum(m.int_waived) as int_waived, sum(m.int_written_off) as int_written_off, sum(m.int_adjusted) as int_adjusted, sum(m.int_relief_rev) as int_relief_rev, sum(m.int_waived_unposted) as int_waived_unposted, sum(m.int_cancelled) as int_cancelled, sum(m.pen_accrued) as pen_accrued, sum(m.pen_accrual_rev) as pen_accrual_rev, sum(m.pen_received) as g0 group by g0.loan_id ) a on a.loan_id = ln.loan_id left join ( select ch.loan_id, sum(if(ch.in_period = 1, ch.amount, 0)) as pen_charged, sum(if(ch.in_period = 0, ch.amount, 0)) as pen_charged_open, sum(ch.amount) as c_pen_charged from chg ch group by ch.loan_id ) c on c.loan_id = ln.loan_id left join gl_loan g on g.loan_id = ln.loan_id ), sl as ( select s.*, s.pen_close - s.pen_close_posted as column.name: description
column.value: Every interest and penalty receipt in the date range with payment type, reversals, net amounts, the GL credit posted, the cash/clearing GL debited, the income GLs of the product, the journal reference and a reconciliation status.
